song.title: The Green Manalishi (With the Two Prong Crown)

guitar.modelsText: Turner Model 1 (Buckingham) / 1959 Gibson Les Paul "Greeny" (Peter Green)
guitar.evidence: Peter Green's 1959 Les Paul ('Greeny', later owned by Gary Moore/Kirk Hammett) is extremely famous; Lindsey Buckingham's Rick Turner Model 1 is also well documented as his main stage guitar from the late 70s onward.
guitar.notes: Upgraded from medium to high given how well documented both instruments are.

tone.target: nasal British fuzz with wah and gritty amp crunch
tone.profile: nasal British fuzz with wah and gritty amp crunch
tone.summary: A fuzzy, gritty signal chain built around a Red Haze or Fuzz pedal, followed by a UK 45 or UK 50 amp model, paired with a Wah effect. The overall tone aims for vintage British rock roughness.
corrections: keep wah on the signature riff

rig.name: Fleetwood Mac - The Green Manalishi (With the Two Prong Crown) - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and background noise inherent in fuzz tones.
Provide initial grit and boost the signal into the fuzz stage.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used here as a general pre-boost/grit source, simulating an early dirty tone before the main fuzz. A dedicated Boost might be better if available.

blocks.purpose: Deliver the core 'main riff fuzz' and vintage British texture.
Execute the signature 'wah sweeps' required for the riff.
blocks.gap: The V-Wah is a general purpose wah, suitable for mimicking the classic sweeping sound needed.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the Marshall/Plexi or Hiwatt-style amp required for classic British rock crunch.
Provide the classic '4x12 cab' sound associated with British rock.
Fine-tune the overall tone, emphasizing mid-range punch and cutting excessive low end.
blocks.gap: A dedicated EQ block is necessary to shape the fuzzy sound for clarity.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle vintage ambience and depth without muddying the aggressive fuzz tone.
blocks.gap: Room reverb is used to provide a sense of space, which complements the vintage rock feel.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the default IR for a more period-appropriate, aggressive 4x12 to enhance the vintage fuzz tone.
